now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#3
now.text: In their sessions, Heather helps Fisk and Vanessa work through Vanessa's affair.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A client Heather counsels with his wife Vanessa through her affair.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The couples therapist helping Fisk and Vanessa past Vanessa's affair.

changes.evidence: The session where Heather has the Fisks talk through Vanessa's affair with Adam is in S1#4 (Sic Semper Systema). In S1#3 Heather only appears celebrating Matt's win at his apartment.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
proposed.text: Grieving Vanessa, Fisk opens up to Heather about his loss and gives her the match to the earring of Vanessa's she secretly took.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Client, then the mayor whose crackdown Heather serves. Confides his grief in her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Couples therapist who joins Fisk's administration after Muse, and whom he confides in after Vanessa dies.

changes.evidence: S2#7 (The Hateful Darkness): Fisk summons Heather to City Hall, tells her he never expected to be alone, and gifts her the other red earring after she stole one from Vanessa's jewelry box at the wake (S2#6), showing he understands her.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
proposed.text: Heather testifies against Karen at her trial, and Matt, defending Karen, asks her on the stand whether she is hiding behind Fisk's administration.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Lawyer Heather dates, until they split and face off in court.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Therapist Matt dates, who serves Fisk and testifies against Karen.

changes.evidence: S2#8 (The Southern Cross): Heather gives her assessment of Karen for the prosecution; Matt objects and cross-examines her, asking if she is hiding behind Fisk's administration. Fandom lists Matt under her enemies as ex-boyfriend.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#6
proposed.text: Heather mourns Vanessa, who has welcomed her into the Fisks' circle, and secretly takes one of her earrings from the bedroom.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A client, then a friend in Fisk's circle whom Heather mourns.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Vanessa's couples therapist, then a friend who mourns her.

changes.evidence: S2#2 and S2#3: Vanessa seeks Heather out at Gracie Mansion, tells her she need not attend alone, asks about Matt, praises her work and seats her by Cashman. Vanessa dies in S2#5; in S2#6 Heather attends the funeral, mourns before her photo and pockets one of her red earrings. Fandom: 'Former Patient and Friend'.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#3
now.text: Matt Murdock defends Hector Ayala in court and outs him as White Tiger to win the case. The two come to respect each other as fellow vigilantes.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hector's lawyer, who outs him as White Tiger, and a fellow vigilante.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Client Matt outs as White Tiger to win. A fellow vigilante he respects.

proposed.text: Matt outs Hector as White Tiger in court and wins his acquittal, though Hector feels betrayed. Hector ignores Matt's warning to stop and is killed that night.

changes.evidence: S1#3: Hector is stunned and feels betrayed when Matt reveals his identity, Matt tells him to stop being White Tiger, he refuses, is acquitted, and is shot dead on patrol that night. Hector never learns Matt is Daredevil, so they do not 'respect each other as fellow vigilantes'.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#3
now.text: Hector Ayala is Soledad Ayala's husband. He saves up to move them into a home of their own before his arrest.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hector's wife, whom he saves up to buy a home for.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Soledad's husband, who saves up for a home of their own.

proposed.text: On the stand, Hector reveals to Soledad that he has bought them a home of their own. He walks out of court free with her, but is killed that same night.

changes.evidence: S1#3: during his testimony Hector tells his wife he has bought them a new place; after the not-guilty verdict they leave court together; that night he is shot dead, leaving her a widow. The current text omits his death, which is the turn between them.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#18
proposed.text: Fitz and Jemma track Holden Radcliffe to Romania, and Fitz begs him to help stop Hive before Hive's Inhumans carry Radcliffe off.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who seeks Radcliffe's help against Hive.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A transhumanist Fitz seeks out for help against Hive.

changes.evidence: S3#18: Radcliffe tests Fitz and Jemma with a fake eye, throws them out, and Fitz pleads for his help against Hive before Daisy and Alisha abduct him. After Hive's defeat in S3#22 he works alongside Fitz and Jemma, which inspires his Life Model Decoys.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S1#10
proposed.text: Held hostage by Kilgrave again, Hope takes her own life so Jessica is free to stop him, and makes her promise to kill him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Investigator who rescues Hope and fights to clear her. Promises her Kilgrave will die.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A missing girl Jessica rescues and fights to clear. Dies to free Jessica.

changes.evidence: S1#10: at Niku, Hope stabs herself in the neck so Jessica no longer has to keep Kilgrave alive for her sake, and as she dies she makes Jessica promise to kill him. A death is a stage; the connection has none.

They never meet. In S2#15 Bobbi tells Hartley that Fury gave Bobbi a secret order to scuttle the Iliad; Hartley only knows of Fury as the director, and nothing Fury does has major consequences for her personally.

The only shared scene (S1#8) is Wesley reporting to Fisk and Owlsley at Melvin's workshop while Owlsley is fitted. Nothing passes between Wesley and Melvin; Melvin's page records no dealings with Wesley. Sharing a room is not a connection.

proposed.title: Daredevil S1#9
proposed.text: Nobu threatens to rip out Wesley's tongue for mistranslating him. Wesley helps Fisk send Nobu after the masked man and watches his body burn.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Yakuza's man in Fisk's alliance, whom Wesley helps set against the masked man.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's right-hand man, who handles Fisk's dealings with Nobu and sets him against the masked man.

changes.evidence: S1#9: when Wesley tries to translate, Nobu threatens to rip out his tongue because he knows Wesley is mistranslating; Wesley and Fisk arrange Nobu's fight with the masked man and stand over his burning body.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S1#9
proposed.text: Left alone with the captive Kilgrave, Jeri lets him tempt her with the power to stop her wife Wendy, and secretly cuts the wires that keep him in check.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A captive killer who tempts Jeri into cutting the wires that hold him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer Kilgrave tempts into cutting the wires that hold him.

changes.evidence: S1#9: Jeri first meets Kilgrave at the decommissioned CDC facility; he hints he could make Wendy disappear, and later she agrees to his idea and cuts the wires. In S1#10 he takes control of her, so the relationship turns from a secret deal to enslavement.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S1#10
proposed.text: Jessica learns that Jeri cut the wires holding Kilgrave, letting him kill his mother and escape, and confronts her over it.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The investigator Jeri keeps hiring, who learns Jeri helped Kilgrave escape.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer who keeps hiring Jessica, then lets Kilgrave escape.

changes.evidence: S1#9 Jeri cuts the wire, so Jessica cannot stop Kilgrave making Louise Thompson kill herself; S1#10 Jessica arrives at Wendy's house and confronts Jeri for her part in it. A clear betrayal before Jeri defends her in S1#13.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S3#13
proposed.text: When Trish takes Kith hostage, Jeri shoots Jessica in the leg and helps Trish flee, then calls Jessica once Trish is hidden for the flight out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Jeri's old hired investigator, whom Jeri shoots to help Trish flee.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Jessica's old employer, who shoots her to help Trish flee.

changes.evidence: S3#13: Jeri shoots Jessica in the leg when she rushes her, leaves with Trish and arranges her escape, then phones Jessica once Trish is locked in the coffin for shipping.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S3#13
proposed.text: Kith thanks Jeri for ending Patseras's threat, but leaves her for good, saying Jeri only saved her from danger Jeri created.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Jeri's college girlfriend, who comes back to her, then leaves for good.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Kith's college girlfriend, whom she leaves for good years later.

changes.evidence: S3#13: Kith comes to thank Jeri but says goodbye, saying Jeri only did it because of a dangerous situation she created; Jeri calls her the last mistake she will make. The romance ending has no stage.

owner_calls.question: The real Grant Ward is dead before Mace appears; they only meet inside the Framework, where Ward is a program built from his memory, not the man. Keep the connection?
options: Drop it: the Framework Ward is not the real Ward
Keep it: the app treats Framework versions as the same character
owner_calls.evidence: S4#17: Framework Ward greets the Patriot as an old comrade and tells him Skye is captured. Grant Ward was killed in S3 and is not plugged into the Framework, unlike Mace, Coulson and Jemma, whose real minds are there.
